subject: trae-agent
title: CI permanently skips 3 of 10 test suites via hard-set env flags, and the skipped corpus has rotted (broken patch targets)
evidence: Makefile:42 + .github/workflows/unit-test.yml:36; skipIf at tests/utils/test_google_client.py:23-25, test_ollama_client_utils.py:22-24, test_openrouter_client_utils.py:23-25; rot at tests/utils/test_google_client.py:28 (patches trae_agent.utils.google_client.genai.Client, module is trae_agent.utils.llm_clients.google_client)
one_why: 563 of 1,708 test LOC (33%) can never execute in CI and the google suite would fail on un-skip, so provider-client behavior has had zero regression signal for an unknown period; nuance over faux-provider-testing: the skip is enforced by the build entry point CI calls, not by the tests themselves.

subject: trae-agent
title: Core agent loop (while-step, LLM step, tool-call handler) has zero test references
evidence: base_agent.py:163-185 (execute_task loop), :205-236 (_run_llm_step), :313-352 (_tool_call_handler); grep of tests/ for these symbols returns no hits; tests/agent/test_trae_agent.py:35-37 mocks out LLMClient entirely
one_why: Loop semantics - step cap handling, exception-abort (base_agent.py:170-175), reflection injection, substring completion gating - are asserted by nothing; every passing CI run proves only tool helpers, which is why verification lands at 4, not the provisional 5/6 range.

subject: trae-agent
title: --docker mode containers only 3 hardcoded tools; MCP and CKG tools silently execute on the host
evidence: trae_agent/agent/base_agent.py:68 (docker_tools=[bash, str_replace_based_edit_tool, json_edit_tool]); fallthrough to host at trae_agent/tools/docker_tool_executor.py:61-65; MCP tools appended to same list at trae_agent/agent/trae_agent.py:70; README.md:181-203 advertises 'run the task in a new container' with no carve-out stated
one_why: Combined with zero approval flow anywhere in the codebase (no approve/confirm gate exists), the advertised sandbox is opt-in AND swiss-cheese: a model choosing the ckg tool or any MCP tool writes to the host while the user believes the task is contained; safety sits at 3, below nanocoder's opt-in-but-complete jail at 5.

subject: trae-agent
title: Every provider exception retried 10x with 3-30s random sleeps, including deterministic context-overflow errors, on append-only history
evidence: trae_agent/utils/llm_clients/retry_utils.py:34-50 (except Exception at :37, sleep :44-50); default max_retries=10 at trae_agent/utils/legacy_config.py:138 and all entries of trae_config.json.example; applied at openai_compatible_base.py:142-147; history append-only at anthropic_client.py:66,111,122; no compaction/trim anywhere in repo
one_why: A context-length 400 is a guaranteed-repeat error, so long tasks burn up to ~5 minutes of sleeps then die (exception also breaks the loop at base_agent.py:170-175); tool-output clamps (run.py:17-26) are the only context-economy mechanism, confirming token-economy=2 and the unbounded-history claim.

subject: trae-agent
title: Task completion decided by substring match on 'done'/'task finished' with base validator always true
evidence: trae_agent/agent/base_agent.py:259-270 (completion_indicators list, any(... in response_lower) at :270), :272-274 (_is_task_completed returns True unconditionally in base)
one_why: A response merely containing the word 'done' ends the run as success (or, in TraeAgent, re-enters via an injected 'The task is incomplete' message at :232), so termination tracks model phrasing rather than state; nuance over the existing heuristic-task-completion concept: here the escape hatch is a hardcoded English substring list with no sentinel protocol.
